name: Cyber impersonation and UPI fraud - 20-turn consultation
note: Turn 1 states facts (Rahul, Rs 18,000) that only the last turn asks about, so it also tests whether memory keeps early details.
questions: Someone made a fake Instagram profile with my photos and is messaging my friends asking for money. My friend Rahul already sent Rs 18,000 to them through UPI. Which laws cover this?
Which section of the IT Act applies to cheating by impersonation using a computer resource?
What is the punishment under that section?
Does the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita also have a section for cheating by personation?
How is cheating by personation different from ordinary cheating?
Should I file the FIR myself, or does Rahul have to file it because he lost the money?
What can we do if the police refuse to register the FIR?
What is a Zero FIR and can we use it here?
The person also posted morphed pictures of me. Is that a separate offence?
Is that offence bailable?
How long do the police have to complete the investigation?
Can Rahul get his money back through the court?
What evidence should we preserve from Instagram and from the UPI app?
Are screenshots admissible as evidence under the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam?
Do we need a certificate for electronic evidence?
If the person behind the profile turns out to be a minor, what changes?
Can I also send a legal notice to the person once we know who it is?
Is there a time limit for filing the complaint?
Should we go to the cyber crime portal first or the police station?
Before I go, summarise my case for me: who lost how much money, which sections you said apply, and the first step I should take.
